labels: Ref: Zeqin Lu, et al., "Broadband silicon photonic directional coupler using asymmetric-waveguide based phase control," Optics Express, 2015

drc_additions.why: floorplan: the deck requires all Si inside FLOORPLAN; M2 extensions: the PDK route leaves each heater contact at an angle at the M1 edge, which fails the 3 um M2-over-M1 overlap rule

four_fiber_ports.detail: 4 optical ports, pitches [127.0, 127.0, 127.0] um (expected 4 at 127.0 um)

heater_pads.detail: 2 electrical pad ports (expected 2, one per heater terminal)

limitations: DRC covers the SiEPIC EBeam deck's geometric rules only; SiEPIC's functional verification (waveguide connectivity, pins, component models) has not been run
The broadband coupler's split has not been verified; ubcpdk has no compact model for it
Only one arm has a heater, so only theta is tunable; there are no phi, a or b phase shifters as in OPA-LAYOUT-001
The grating-coupler model in ubcpdk is a generic placeholder (6 dB, 35 nm), not measured data
Not submitted to or checked by the foundry
